meta.name: understand-chat
meta.description: Use when you need to ask questions about a codebase or understand code using a knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用知识图谱问答代码库，快速理解代码结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解陌生代码库的结构和逻辑
copy.tagline_en: Query codebase with knowledge graph to understand code quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the structure and logic of an unfamiliar codebase

howto.what: 装上后，当你在项目里提问代码相关问题时，Claude 会先读取项目根目录的 `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json` 知识图谱，用关键词搜索相关节点，顺着依赖关系找到关联部分，最后结合具体文件、函数和架构层次回答你。
howto.when: 当你想了解当前代码库的某一部分、询问某个函数或模块如何工作、或需要借助知识图谱理解代码时触发。如果项目根目录没有知识图谱文件，会提示你先运行 `/understand`。

say.note: 它会沿知识图谱的 imports 边找出相关文件。
它会搜索节点并追踪调用来源。

say.text: 这个项目用的是什么技术栈？
say.note: 它会读取 project 元数据来回答。

howto.what_en: When you ask code-related questions in a project, Claude will first read the `.understand-anything/knowledge-graph.json` file, search relevant nodes by keywords, follow dependency edges, then answer with specific files, functions and layers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about a specific part of the codebase, e.g. how a function or module works, or need to understand code via the knowledge graph. If the graph file is missing, it will prompt you to run `/understand` first.

say_en.text: Which files does the `auth` module depend on?
say_en.note: It follows imports edges in the graph.
It searches nodes and traces callers.

say_en.text: What tech stack is used in this project?
